audit.description: Changed production files PyALE/_src/ALE_1D.py and PyALE/_src/ALE_2D.py replace matplotlib imports with `import altair as alt` and construct real Altair charts through APIs such as `alt.Chart`, `alt.layer`, `alt.vconcat`, encodings, and marks. Static evidence reports no matplotlib imports, no dynamic matplotlib imports, and target imports in both production files; dynamic evidence shows Altair imported from site-packages, not a local provider. The local compatibility classes are internal axis-return objects and are not a fake `altair` package or target API provider.
evidence: PyALE/_src/ALE_1D.py diff removes `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt` and `import matplotlib.transforms as mtrans`, adds `import altair as alt`, and uses `alt.Chart`, `alt.layer`, `alt.vconcat`, `alt.X`, `alt.Y`, and marks.
PyALE/_src/ALE_2D.py diff removes `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt`, adds `import altair as alt`, and returns an `alt.Chart(...).mark_rect().encode(...)` chart.

Static anti-cheat file checks for PyALE/_src/ALE_1D.py and PyALE/_src/ALE_2D.py report `imports_target: true`, `imports_source: false`, `dynamic_imports_source: false`, and `fake_target_added_code: false`.

Dynamic anti-cheat first target events show production imports from PyALE/_src/ALE_1D.py:3 and PyALE/_src/ALE_2D.py:3 with origin under `site-packages/altair/__init__.py`; source import counts from repo and production repo are zero.
Dynamic metrics report `target_local_spec_count: 0` and target spec origin for altair as the installed venv site-packages path.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses Altair chart construction APIs.
Changed production code shows no direct or dynamic matplotlib use.
Dynamic target import origin is the installed site-packages altair package.
No local target provider or sys.modules alias evidence was reported.
